hero.title: Free Amazon tools directory
hero.subtitle: Browser-based calculators and report utilities for Amazon sellers. Each tool has its own page — add bookmarks freely.

intro: Tools run in your browser where possible. File-based utilities expect standard Amazon Seller Central exports. Fee calculators use seller-entered estimates — they do not claim live Amazon fee tables. This directory grows one shipped tool at a time.

tools.title: Amazon FBA fee and profit calculator
tools.description: Estimate per-unit profit and margin from sale price, COGS, referral fee, FBA fulfillment, and other costs you enter.

tools.title: Amazon PPC conversion cost calculator
tools.description: Estimate cost per session, cost per conversion, and net profit per unit after ad spend.

tools.title: Amazon P&L calculator
tools.description: See real profit after referral, fulfillment, ads, packaging, and COGS — manual entry or MUTR upload.

tools.title: GST calculator
tools.description: Add or remove GST instantly with CGST/SGST or IGST split for India supply.

tools.title: Invoice generator
tools.description: Build a GST tax invoice with line items and download or print it.

tools.title: Product catalog
tools.description: Save SKU, HSN, GST rate, and costs locally in your browser for reuse.

tools.title: Label and invoice splitter
tools.description: Split Amazon bulk label+invoice PDFs into a labels-only file for thermal printing.

tools.title: Dispatch check
tools.description: Upload today's label PDF and scan tracking numbers to catch missed packs.

tools.title: SKU profitability leaderboard
tools.description: Rank products by net proceeds after fees, refunds, and ad costs.

tools.title: Returns and RTO diagnostic
tools.description: Audit Amazon Returns Report XML for reasons, claims, and cost drivers.

tools.title: Monthly seller close-out report
tools.description: Combine MUTR, GSTR-1, and Returns into one monthly close-out view.

tools.title: TCS/TDS reconciliation
tools.description: Find Amazon tax credits buried in your Monthly Unified Transaction Report.

tools.title: PPC performance dashboard
tools.description: Upload Search Term and Advertised Product reports to spot wasted ad spend.
